# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 06 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## En Bloc Reform: Lower Consent Thresholds Proposed for Older Condos

- **Parliament introduces bill to cut en bloc consent threshold for 40–59-year-old developments** - The Land Titles (Strata) (Amendment) Bill 2026, introduced on 4 August, proposes reducing the owner consent required for a collective sale from 80% to 70% for developments aged 40–59 years. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/proposed-en-bloc-consent-thresholds/)

- **Condos aged 60 and above could see threshold drop further to 65%** - Under the same proposed reforms, developments 60 years or older would need only 65% owner consent to proceed with a collective sale, down from the current 80%. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/new-proposal-revive-en-bloc-hopes-for-older-condos/)

- **Developers of large collective sale projects get extended timeline under new ABSD rules** - Singapore's updated ABSD rules now give developers of large collective sale projects six to seven years to complete and sell units, extended from the previous 5.5 years. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/new-change-boost-en-bloc-chances-for-older-condos-buyers-still-need-to-be-careful/)

## HDB Resale Market: Volume Up, Prices Softer

- **HDB resale volume hits 2026 high in July with 2,660 transactions** - July recorded the highest monthly resale volume of the year so far, though the resale price index continued to soften and now sits 0.7% below its level a year ago. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-transactions-hit-2026-high-in-july-as-prices-continue-to-fall/)

- **Bishan executive maisonette sets new record at S$1.65 million** - A high-floor executive maisonette in Bishan changed hands on 4 August 2026 for S$1.65 million, making it Singapore's most expensive executive flat on record and the priciest HDB resale flat in Bishan. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/s1-65m-bishan-maisonette-becomes-singapores-priciest-executive-flat-to-date/)

## Rentals and New Launches

- **Private and HDB rents both edged up in Q2 2026 despite more homes entering the market** - Private residential rents rose 0.7% in Q2 2026 while HDB rents grew 0.4%, with tighter supply and steady tenant demand cited as the key drivers, and growth projected to continue through the rest of 2026. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/why-rental-prices-in-singapore-are-still-climbing-despite-more-homes-coming-this-year/)

- **Dunearn House, first project at Turf City, sells 56% of units on launch weekend** - The development drew 5,900 visitors at its preview but moved only 212 units during its first sales weekend, falling short of expectations. [Source](https://www.propertysoul.com/2026/08/02/dunearn-house/)
